text_block_list.text: During summer training camp, while I was doing beach training with Mejiro McQueen—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...Phew. Shall we take a break and rehydrate?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Heh... Haaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
—Whoa, that pitch is way too fast!
There's no way I can hit that...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, scored some points!
Let's keep this momentum going!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Are those... Ryan and Dober?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
They are playing beach volleyball.
How delightful that looks.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Huh, really!?
Are you interested too, McQueen-chan?

(Ines Fujin—
an Umamusume brimming with big sister energy
who's always looking out for others.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
My, Ines!
Did you come here together with those two?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: That's right. I was planning on challenging Ryan-chan next, but—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Since you're here, why don't you join in too, Mac-chan,
and make it a two-on-two match?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Are you sure?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Beach volleyball should be great for strengthening
my legs and core... Alright.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I would be most obliged.
Trainer, I shall be gone for a brief moment.

Mejiro McQueen & Mejiro Dober
                  vs.
Mejiro Ryan & Ines Fujin
—A heated battle between the two pairs has begun!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Whoa!?
McQueen, the ball's heading your way...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Eh, aah...!
I won't make it in time...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yay! We scored another point
off of McQueen and Dober!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ryan-chan is amazing...!
She's scoring so many points all by herself~!

Under the scorching, relentless sun,
the battle continued—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, haaah...
It's getting pretty rough, huh...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Indeed, this heat simply drains one's stamina...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, the posture unique to volleyball
is quite something too..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, haaah...
This really is tough, yeah... But—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Times like this are precisely when
I've got to show some spirit...!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Because I am—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: —I've been training for this all along!!
(SMACKKKK!!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: ...All right, scored another point!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
No way...! Even in this state,
she still hasn't lost heart...?!
Before long, the sun began to set—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Haaah... I've been through quite an ordeal...
choice_data_list: That was a fierce battle, wasn't it...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, challenging Ryan of all people
to a ball game was definitely a mistake...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: "Still, where on earth does her incredible clutch ability come from, I wonder?"
choice_data_list: Maybe it's because of physical strength...?
It really comes down to guts after all.
I think it really comes down to guts after all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: "Still, where on earth does her incredible clutch ability come from, I wonder?"
choice_data_list: Maybe it's because of physical strength...?
It really comes down to guts after all.
I think it really comes down to guts after all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Physical strength, is it...?
Indeed...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Ryan's muscle training routine
is truly out of the ordinary, isn't it...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: "However, if that's the case, could I also develop clutch strength by training my body?"
choice_data_list: Should I ramp up the strength training?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it never hurts to give it a try.
Let's do it, starting tomorrow!

Just as Mejiro McQueen wished,
we decided to intensify our muscle training the next day.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: G-Guts...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Indeed, that is where one ultimately ends up, isn't it...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...Alright, then I shall follow your example
and try building up some grit myself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Even so, where should I even begin...?
choice_data_list: How about we start by cutting out sweets completely?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Wha, that's...!
It certainly seems like it would build endurance, but...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"However...
please let me think about it for just a moment!"
